policy_content: Customers may request a delivery status update when an order is delayed. The support system must verify the actual order status before responding. No delivery date may be invented.
Customers may request a return within 30 days of delivery. Refund eligibility must be verified against the order record. Any refund decision requires human approval.
Cancellation requests can be considered before an order is shipped. The support system must verify the order status. Cancellation decisions require human approval.
